notes: Piece counts match the 50-piece parts list (every type count checked).
Head = b1-b16, arms = b17-b22, leg A = b23-b36 (foot b23-b33, lower leg b34-b36), leg B = b37-b50 (foot b37-b48, lower leg b49-b50).
The booklet pictures are small, so which stud each piece sits on is partly inferred, especially the rests_on lists for the head clips, sockets and cheese slopes.
Assumed that the head's four clip plates hold the two horns (b3, b4) and the two arm handle bars (b7, b8), and that the lower-leg 14419 ball goes into the head 14418 sockets.
Foot ball plate 14417 (b29 / b43) joins the lower leg 14419 socket. b34 and b49 start their own sub-assemblies, so their rests_on is empty.
The pearl gold slope 3048c pieces are listed as resting on the round brick, with an extra pin join.
Element 6039482 is lego-14419 (listed as 6414554), and 4620917/4621917 is the 92946 slope with cutout.
position is null for every piece.
